Master Services Agreement

between Meridian Analytics Ltd and the Customer

1. Term and Renewal

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twenty-four months. The Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve-month periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty days before the end of the then-current term.

2. Service Levels

The Provider will make the Service available at least 99.9% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance will be announced at least five business days in advance and performed outside normal business hours.

3. Customer Obligations

  1. Keep account credentials confidential
  2. Use the Service in accordance with the documentation
  3. Maintain supported versions of any client software
  4. Notify the Provider within 24 hours of any suspected security incident
